ayahOccurrences.text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine singular (form V) imperative verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَتَهَجَّدْ is in the derivative form: تَهَجَّدْ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
هـ/ج/د   h–j–d to sleep in the night or in the latter part of the night; to stay awake at night; (of a camel) to rest the fore part of the neck upon the ground. Of this root, تَهَجَّد tahajjad occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَهَجَّدْ tahajjad [imper. of v. V تَهَجَّدَ tahajjada, intrans.] to perform voluntary prayers in the depths of night

(17:79) وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةً لَكَ and in some part of the night, pray, as an extra offering of your own [for your own benefit].
